🎬 20 YEARS OF CASINO ROYALE 🎬
Casino Royale released on November 17, 2006 — 20 years ago — and Daniel Craig's Bond was born.
To mark the anniversary, we're spotlighting a fan edit from the collection: James Bond - Casino Royale - Extended Cut - Fan Edit.
The extended cut of Craig's first outing as 007 — the parkour chase, the poker table, all of it.
DM us for the link — THE WORLD'S LARGEST FAN EDIT COLLECTION.
